description: A shop-floor timeline in the Svelte 5 scheduler that collapses non-working time: collapseNonWorking folds nights into a thin gap and collapseWeekends folds weekends into a marker, with collapsedGapPx setting the gap, so working hours fill the width. A zoom stepper scales the axis from hourly detail out to a whole week, and bars, drag and the now-line all map through the compressed axis; the Table shows the same rows.
keywords: svelte 5 scheduler collapse non working hours

faq.question: How does the axis skip nights?
faq.answer: With collapseNonWorking the hours outside businessHours are drawn as a narrow gap of collapsedGapPx pixels instead of at full width, and positions are computed through the compressed scale.

faq.question: How is zoom controlled?
faq.answer: zoom is a level index the stepper changes; each level sets the tick unit and pixel width, from hourly to weekly.

faq.question: Do drags respect the compressed axis?
faq.answer: Yes. Pointer positions are mapped back through the same scale, so a bar dropped after a folded night lands at the next working hour.
